chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her early 40s, elegant, long wavy dark-brown hair worn loose, wearing a fitted burgundy sleeveless home top, loose cream linen trousers and a thin gold bracelet
chars.BOY: an 18-year-old Moroccan young man with short black curly hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.GIRL: an 18-year-old Moroccan girl with straight black hair in a high ponytail, wearing an oversized lavender sweatshirt and blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the boy's seat at a dining table in a bright modern Casablanca apartment: MOM leans over the table, pen in hand, explaining a physics exercise in an open notebook, relaxed at home in her sleeveless top, looking straight at the boy with a warm confident smile; head-to-waist framing, BOY's shoulder and hand with a pencil in the foreground. Stylized 2D animation, clean lines, warm colors.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Dining table covered with physics and chemistry textbooks, a small whiteboard with scribbled formulas propped on a chair (no readable text); MOM stands drawing on it while GIRL and BOY sit taking notes, all three focused. Stylized 2D animation, clean lines, warm colors.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: BOY and GIRL sit side by side at the table doing homework, calm and ordinary, a teapot with mint tea and glasses between them, afternoon light from the window. Stylized 2D animation, clean lines, warm colors.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In front of a Moroccan lycee gate in Casablanca, BOY and GIRL walk out with backpacks among other students, chatting happily, palm trees and a white wall behind. Stylized 2D animation, clean lines, warm colors.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment kitchen doorway, MOM hands BOY a plate of fresh msemen and a glass of juice with a big smile, while GIRL in the background raises an eyebrow, arms crossed, slightly jealous. Stylized 2D animation, clean lines, warm colors.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the dining table: MOM walks into the living room in her burgundy sleeveless home top and cream trousers, hair loose, completely at ease, carrying a book; BOY in the foreground freezes, eyes wide, pencil stopped mid-air, awkward. Stylized 2D animation, clean lines, warm colors.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: MOM sits relaxed on the sofa with her legs tucked under her, laughing and chatting casually with BOY who sits stiffly on a chair, smiling nervously, hands on his knees. Stylized 2D animation, clean lines, warm colors.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: MOM sits very close next to BOY at the table, pointing at an atom diagram drawn in his notebook (no readable text), explaining passionately; BOY is not looking at the notebook at all, he stares at her face, dazed. Stylized 2D animation, clean lines, warm colors.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of BOY at the table, chin resting on his hand, lost in thought and blushing, eyes looking off to the side toward someone out of frame, the notebook forgotten in front of him, soft evening light. Stylized 2D animation, clean lines, warm colors.
